DATE – Counter Staff
Routes Application to
Engineer

Legible, detailed site plan(s), elevations, and section view(s)
of the proposed Parklet designed and stamped by a licensed
architect or engineer. Plans shall show and label the
business address, business frontage, and neighboring
frontages. Plans shall also depict all nearby existing sidewalk
obstructions and public right-of-way features such as trees
and tree boxes, curb height, utility poles and boxes, hydrants,
parking meters, crosswalks, parking space markings, curb
markings, storm water catch basins, bike lanes, etc.
Plans shall also include elevations, section view(s), and/or
product specification for seating, including wheelchair
accessible seating, and furnishings to be included within the
Parklet. Plans shall also show the location and type of
heating equipment, where provided, within the Parklet. All
parklet customers must have a seat; no standees.
Parklet designs shall conform with the City of Oakland’s
Parklet Program Guidelines, except upon review and
approval of the City Engineer or designee:
OakDOT staff time to review and to inspect the installed parklet, and an annual parking space
OakDOT is committed to supporting businesses during the transition to the permanent Parklet
